privacy.intro: Amen is a Christian app for Bible reading, prayer and spiritual reflection. This policy explains how personal information is used in the app, including accounts, reading preferences, Nema AI chat, audio and subscriptions. The information processed depends on the features you choose.
summary: Nema uses an enhanced Google AI model to provide AI chat. Your message and relevant conversation context are sent to Google to generate a response.
Guest use creates an account identifier without requiring an email address. Local notes and highlights are separate from account-based saved content. Purchases are managed through Apple.
Prayer, faith preferences and conversations may contain sensitive personal information. Your privacy rights and any required consent remain protected.
Contact support at amenapphilfe@gmail.com for privacy requests. Apple subscriptions must be canceled separately from deleting the app or an amen account.

sections.title: Privacy contact
paragraphs: For questions about how the amen app uses personal information, contact support at {{email}}. You can use this address for access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, withdrawal of consent and other privacy requests.

This policy describes processing associated with the amen app. Apple and Google also process information for their own services under their respective privacy policies. Their responsibilities do not replace the responsibilities associated with amen or reduce your rights.

sections.title: Support and email correspondence
paragraphs: If you contact support, your email address, message, attachments and details needed to resolve the request are processed through the support email service. Please do not send passwords, complete payment details or sensitive information that is not needed to answer your question.

Article 6(1)(b) applies to requests about your contract or pre-contractual questions; Article 6(1)(f) applies to other correspondence and handling complaints. Relevant correspondence may be retained to resolve the issue, meet legal duties or establish and defend claims. Sensitive information requires an additional lawful condition.

sections.title: Accounts, authentication and profile
paragraphs: During onboarding, amen can create a guest account without requiring an email address or Sign in with Apple. The account has a unique identifier and session information. Your chosen name and supported saved activity are associated with that account identifier. Guest access does not require verification of your real-world identity; account-linked information can still be personal data. Account identifiers, session credentials and preferences are stored with account services and on the device to maintain access and supported synchronization. Access after signing out, reinstalling or changing devices depends on the available authentication and recovery information. Account information also includes creation and update times.

You can link supported guest-account information through Sign in with Apple. Apple may provide an identifier, name and an email or private relay address; amen does not receive your Apple-account password. Linking can associate or transfer supported conversations, profile and progress records, depending on existing account information and successful completion. It does not make every device-only item available elsewhere. Returning users with an existing email/password account can use the available login and password-reset controls. Account services process the required credentials and recovery information. The usual bases are Article 6(1)(b), proportionate security under Article 6(1)(f), and legal duties under Article 6(1)(c).

sections.title: Onboarding answers and faith personalization
paragraphs: Onboarding uses answers about faith goals, a faith vision, reading habits, obstacles and personal struggles to select relevant content. These answers are saved locally in the current flow. Denomination is also saved with account chat settings and can be included in personalized Google AI requests. Some onboarding reflections are selected from prepared, localized text rather than generated by AI. The current denomination step requires a selection to continue.

These answers can reveal religious beliefs or personal circumstances and are covered by the sensitive-data section. Each purpose and recipient requires an appropriate lawful basis and, where applicable, an additional condition for sensitive data. Continuing onboarding, reading this policy or allowing a device permission does not by itself provide explicit consent for sensitive-data processing. Contact support at {{email}} about your answers, preferences or privacy requests.

sections.title: Reading activity, notes and personalization
paragraphs: Amen uses language, Bible-version choices, reading activity, streaks, achievements and settings to provide the selected features. Bible notes and verse highlights are saved in local app storage in the current version. Account-based saved verses, saved chat messages, conversations, profile information and supported progress records use cloud storage where available. Signing in does not by itself synchronize every locally saved item across devices. Device and backup settings can also affect local information.

The purpose is to provide reading, progress and personalization functions, usually under Article 6(1)(b), with additional protection where information reveals beliefs or other sensitive circumstances. Use the relevant note, highlight or conversation controls to manage saved content. Keep a separate copy of information important to you; this does not reduce your rights to a conforming service. Public profile and ranking visibility is explained separately below.

sections.title: Public profile and leaderboards
paragraphs: Leaderboards display ranking information to other users, including your display name, profile picture where available, country flag, reading streak, badges, score and rank. Supported progress records are synchronized with the ranking service to calculate and show these results. Profile and ranking information is therefore different from a private note or conversation.

The country code for the flag comes from the device's region setting rather than GPS coordinates. Choose a name and photo suitable for this visibility and avoid confidential information in profile fields. Shared image links may also allow others to view the image. Ranking processing generally supports the feature under Article 6(1)(b), with additional protection for sensitive information. Contact {{email}} about displayed information or privacy requests.

sections.title: Nema AI chat
paragraphs: Nema uses an enhanced Google AI model to provide AI chat. Your message and relevant conversation history are sent to Google to generate a response. Context may include your name, selected language and faith preferences when used for personalization. Relevant messages can also be sent to Google to create a short conversation title. The conversation is generated by AI rather than a human adviser.

Google AI services may also support Bible explanations and personalized reading recommendations. Relevant answers, passage references or text are used for the feature you request. Prepared onboarding reflections are handled as described in the onboarding section. Avoid sharing passwords, payment details or confidential information about another person. Requested features generally rely on Article 6(1)(b), with an additional lawful condition for sensitive personal data.

sections.title: Google AI services
paragraphs: Google processes the information sent to its AI services to generate the requested answer. Its handling of inputs and responses depends on the applicable service terms and settings, including provisions concerning model improvement, safety and retention. Google's AI service terms are available at {{google}}.

Security, abuse prevention and legal obligations can involve temporary retention or review of AI requests. This policy does not promise that every provider record is deleted immediately. For Google's own privacy information, see {{googlePrivacy}}. You may contact support with questions about the handling of your chat information.

sections.title: Conversation history and deletion
paragraphs: Conversations, messages, responses and titles may be saved locally and with your account so you can return to them. Closing a conversation or the app does not delete saved history. Saved messages and related account records can be separate from the conversation currently shown on screen.

Use available conversation controls or contact support at {{email}} to request deletion or a copy. Removal from active history, associated records, provider processing and backup expiry are separate parts of handling a request. Deletion does not automatically recall exported or shared copies. Records needed for legal obligations or claims may remain with restricted use.

sections.title: Read-aloud audio
paragraphs: When you request generated speech, the app sends the text to be read, voice settings and generation instructions to Google. This can include Bible text, a devotional or a prayer. Generated audio and voice information may be cached on your device for playback.

Read-aloud generates speech from text and does not itself record your microphone. Relevant text is processed to provide the requested audio; provider security and legal records may also apply. Playback generally relies on Article 6(1)(b), with additional protection if the text contains sensitive personal information.

sections.title: Bible Lock and Screen Time
paragraphs: Bible Lock uses Apple's Screen Time functions when you authorize them. Apple-provided selection identifiers for chosen apps, app categories and supported web domains, together with schedules, unlock settings and reading progress, are stored locally for the app and its extensions to provide the feature. Authorization does not give amen general access to messages or browsing history. You can manage or revoke Screen Time access in system settings.

For an AI reading recommendation, your selected need, requested reading length, preferred language and recent chapter references can be sent to Google. Recent references help avoid repeated recommendations and are also stored locally for this feature. Processing generally provides the requested feature under Article 6(1)(b), with additional protection for sensitive information. Apple controls its own framework processing; device permissions do not supply consent for unrelated analytics or sensitive-data purposes.

sections.title: Profile photos and device permissions
paragraphs: When you save a profile photo, the selected image is stored with the relevant account service. It can appear with your profile or ranking information. Shared image links may give others access to that image. Amen uses the image you select; adding a profile photo should not be understood as making every image in your photo library available to the app.

You can manage relevant photo and Screen Time permissions in iOS settings. Saving wallpapers or Live Photos uses the permission needed to add the selected content to Photos, as explained below. Denying a permission can limit its feature. A device-capability authorization is separate from consent to advertising or sensitive-data processing. Apple's privacy information is available at {{applePrivacy}}.

sections.title: Notifications and reminder schedules
paragraphs: For remote verse and prayer reminders, amen sends the device push token, app language, time zone, enabled reminder types and selected delivery times to the notification service. Registration can be associated with your account. Supported streak or trial reminders can instead be scheduled locally on the device. This information is used to provide the reminder and delivery features you choose.

You can change reminder preferences in the app and notification permission in iOS settings. Delivery depends on permissions, device settings and available services. Revoking a permission does not itself establish that every previously registered token or service record has been deleted; contact {{email}} for deletion requests. A trial reminder does not cancel a subscription or replace Apple's renewal information. The trial reminder mentioned during onboarding refers to an email from Apple about the upcoming end of your trial, not an email sent by amen. Apple handles these emails using your Apple Account information under {{applePrivacy}}. Amen does not control Apple's email delivery or timing.

sections.title: Days with Jesus and widgets
paragraphs: If you use Days with Jesus, amen saves the date you choose locally to calculate the day count. You can change or reset the date in the feature. The date, Bible content, preferences and access information needed by supported widgets are shared with the app's extensions on the device. Bible Lock also uses shared device data for its authorized functions.

Widgets and notification previews can show faith-related content on your Home Screen or Lock Screen. People who can see the screen may also see that content. Choose widgets and previews with this visibility in mind. Requested widget functions generally rely on Article 6(1)(b), with additional protection where information reveals religious beliefs or other sensitive data.

sections.title: Comics, wallpapers, scenes and music
paragraphs: When you open comics, wallpapers, 360° scenes or audio, amen requests relevant content from delivery services and can keep local copies or caches for display and playback. Delivery involves the requested file and ordinary network connection information, including the IP address used for the connection. Supported background-music preferences are saved locally and can also be stored with your profile to provide the selected listening experience.

The current 360° viewer displays downloaded panoramas controlled by touch; it does not use the device camera to capture the surrounding room. Saving a wallpaper or Live Photo adds selected content to Photos with the requested permission. Copies saved to Photos or shared outside amen are separate from account records and are not automatically recalled by account deletion. Media processing generally provides your requested feature under Article 6(1)(b).

sections.title: Purchases and Apple
paragraphs: Apple handles App Store payments and billing. Amen does not receive your full payment-card number from an Apple in-app purchase. Purchase validation services use account identifiers, transaction details, products, trial status and subscription access information to recognize your purchases. Apple's purchase and usage rules are available at {{appleTerms}}.

Purchase status and technical identifiers may be associated with your amen account and used for subscription attribution. Access administration generally relies on Article 6(1)(b), legally required records on Article 6(1)(c), and optional marketing processing on consent where required. Apple's handling of purchase information is described in {{applePrivacy}}.

sections.title: TikTok measurement and app attribution
paragraphs: App versions introducing direct TikTok measurement use the TikTok App Events SDK to report installations and qualifying free-trial starts for advertising measurement and optimization. A purchase-validation service confirms trial status before the app reports a trial start. SDK transmissions can include event names, timestamps and event identifiers, app and session information, device identifiers such as Apple’s vendor identifier (IDFV), device model and system version, language, IP/network information and technical diagnostics. Access to Apple’s advertising identifier (IDFA) depends on Apple’s tracking authorization. TikTok’s processing is described in {{tiktokPrivacy}}.

The direct TikTok integration does not add prayer text, chat content or onboarding answers to its configured marketing events. Even without those contents, use of a faith-related app can suggest religious interests. TikTok may use event data for reporting, advertising optimization and, where permitted, matching and audience creation. Older installed app versions can still use previous measurement integrations that report onboarding steps, paywall interactions and purchase-related activity. The data flow therefore depends on the installed version; updating the app does not erase information previously received by providers. Crash data may also be used for analytics and investigating technical faults.

sections.title: Apple tracking choice and anonymous attribution
paragraphs: In versions using the direct TikTok integration, the SDK starts when the app opens, before the Apple App Tracking Transparency (ATT) request in the opening onboarding carousel. The SDK includes the ATT status in requests. Declining or not answering the prompt does not disable the SDK or stop every event, configuration or diagnostic request. The choice must be respected for tracking across other companies’ apps and websites; it does not restrict access to amen features. You can manage Apple’s permission in Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking or contact {{email}} about privacy choices.

Apple’s SKAdNetwork (SKAN) provides a separate form of privacy-preserving advertising measurement that can operate without ATT authorization. Apple controls the aggregated postbacks, their timing and whether detailed conversion information is available; an ordinary SDK event is separate from a SKAN postback. See {{appleSKAN}}. This policy is information, not consent: where applicable law requires prior consent for SDK collection or transmission, that requirement still applies. Apple’s ATT choice does not replace every consent or other legal condition.

sections.title: Religious beliefs and other sensitive data
paragraphs: Denomination, prayer, faith goals and conversations may reveal religious beliefs, health or other special categories of data under Article 9 GDPR. Such processing needs both an Article 6 basis and an applicable Article 9 condition, ordinarily explicit consent for optional faith personalization. Reading a policy, using the app or allowing Apple tracking is not that explicit consent.

You may request withdrawal, restriction or deletion at {{email}} and change available preferences. Withdrawal does not invalidate earlier lawful processing. Avoid entering sensitive data about other people without authority. Disclosure of sensitive choices to analytics providers needs its own justification; this document cannot create consent or make an otherwise unlawful disclosure lawful.

sections.title: Children and parental authorization
paragraphs: Use of amen must comply with applicable child-data rules, legally effective parental authorization where required, and the conditions of external services. An App Store content rating does not replace these requirements. Google's AI service conditions are linked in this policy and remain relevant to features that use those services.

Where consent is needed, the requirements for children depend on local law. Contact support if you believe a child's information was processed without the necessary authorization. We will investigate the request and arrange the restriction or deletion required in the circumstances.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: The relevant bases depend on the purpose: Article 6(1)(b) for requested account, reading, AI and purchase-access services; Article 6(1)(c) for legal duties; Article 6(1)(f) for proportionate security, service operation and handling non-contractual correspondence; Article 6(1)(a) for processing requiring consent.

Device-storage rules may also require consent unless access is strictly necessary. Special-category data additionally needs an Article 9 condition. We cannot replace consent-required advertising with a blanket legitimate-interest claim. Required account information is needed for the relevant service; optional information and permissions can be declined, with possible limits to their features.

sections.title: Service providers and other recipients
paragraphs: Recipient categories include providers of account authentication, cloud hosting and storage, purchase validation, app measurement, advertising attribution and support email. Google provides AI services. Apple provides App Store purchases, sign-in, notifications and relevant device functions. Information shared depends on the feature and purpose. TikTok receives the advertising measurement data described above in app versions with its direct SDK integration; see {{tiktokPrivacy}}.

Necessary information may also be shared with authorized support personnel, professional advisers or authorities where legally required. Processing and any international transfers remain subject to applicable safeguards. Contact {{email}} for more information about recipients and arrangements relevant to your information.

sections.title: International transfers
paragraphs: Providers can operate or give authorized support access outside your country, including outside the European Economic Area. Server region, support access and further subprocessors must all be considered; choosing an EU database region does not by itself rule out every international transfer.

Where GDPR transfer rules apply, a transfer needs an applicable safeguard, such as an adequacy decision covering the recipient or appropriate contractual safeguards, including standard contractual clauses and any necessary additional measures. Contact us for information about the safeguards relevant to your data. We do not promise universal EU-only storage.

sections.title: Retention criteria and backups
paragraphs: Account and synchronized content are retained to provide your account and chosen features until removed or no longer needed. Local caches depend on device and app controls. Support records depend on the request and legal obligations. Transaction records, fraud evidence and disputed matters may need longer retention under applicable law.

Cloud, AI and measurement services retain information according to the relevant purpose, agreements and legal duties. Deleted records may remain in protected backups until they expire, and legally required records may be retained with restricted access. Contact support for the retention criteria applicable to your information.

sections.title: Deleting your account
paragraphs: You can request account deletion through the app. If you cannot access the account or the request does not complete, contact support at {{email}}. Proportionate identity verification may be needed to prevent unauthorized access or deletion; you will not be asked to send a password. Deleting an account and removing device-only content are separate operations. Local notes, highlights or preferences can remain independently of the account; use their available controls and the Days with Jesus reset control, or contact support for help.

Uninstalling the app alone does not delete cloud account records. Removing access through Sign in with Apple is also separate from requesting deletion of information held by amen. Neither app removal nor amen account deletion automatically cancels an Apple subscription: cancel it separately through {{cancel}}. Device copies, exported content, backup expiry and records subject to lawful retention are distinct from removal of the active account.

sections.title: Your rights and complaints
paragraphs: Where the GDPR applies, you can request access, correction, erasure, restriction and, where the conditions are met, portability. You may withdraw consent and object to processing based on legitimate interests for reasons relating to your situation. You may object to direct marketing at any time.

Send requests to {{email}}. We normally respond within one month; legally permitted extensions require notice and reasons. Requests are normally free, subject to statutory exceptions. You may complain to the supervisory authority where you live, work or believe an infringement occurred. Contacting amen first is not a condition for complaining.

sections.title: Security and automated processing
paragraphs: Data transfers use encrypted connections where supported, with access controls and other technical and organizational safeguards appropriate to the processing. No online service can guarantee absolute security. Protect your device and account, and report suspected unauthorized access.

AI generates responses and personalization, and automated checks can manage access or purchase entitlement. These functions are not presented as decisions about legal rights, credit, employment or medical treatment. If you believe an automated result significantly affects you, contact us for review and the protections applicable to that decision.

sections.title: Changes and related documents
paragraphs: The date and version at the top identify this notice. We will update it when services, recipients or legal requirements change and provide additional notice where required. Publishing a revised notice does not authorize a new purpose that requires consent.

The {{terms}} explain use of the app and purchases. Updates to this policy do not reduce mandatory privacy rights. Contact support at {{email}} if you have questions about this notice or how your information is used.

terms.intro: Amen is a Christian app for Bible reading, prayer and spiritual reflection. These terms explain use of the app, including Nema AI chat, account features and subscriptions. Read them alongside the privacy policy and the offer shown before a purchase. Your statutory consumer rights remain protected.
summary: Nema uses an enhanced Google AI model to provide AI chat. Responses can be inaccurate; check important answers and Bible quotations.
The purchase screen shows the price, billing period, trial conditions and included access before you confirm.
Apple subscriptions renew until canceled. Deleting the app or your amen account does not cancel Apple billing.
These terms preserve statutory consumer rights. Apple purchase rules and the applicable app license also apply.

sections.title: Scope and agreement
paragraphs: These terms apply to the amen iOS app and its Bible, prayer and Christian reflection features. Contact support at {{email}} with questions about the agreement. Apple's relationship with you for its own App Store services follows the rules applicable to your storefront; see {{appleTerms}}.

A contract is formed through the applicable registration, acceptance or purchase process after the relevant terms and offer are made available. Mere publication of these terms is not a substitute for acceptance where it is required. An individual agreement and mandatory law take precedence over inconsistent general wording.

sections.title: What amen provides
paragraphs: Amen supports Christian Bible reading, prayer and reflection through saved verses, highlights, notes, devotionals, reading progress and related features. Depending on the version and access level, it also provides Bible comics, wallpapers, touch-controlled 360° scenes, background music, Days with Jesus and widgets. Nema uses an enhanced Google AI model to provide AI chat. Some reading recommendations and audio features also use AI; Bible Lock uses Apple's Screen Time functions.

The actual offer and purchase screen define paid access. Some media must be downloaded before use, and saving or sharing content remains subject to its license. These terms do not promise a fixed number of free messages, a particular AI model, every Bible translation, perpetual operation or features advertised for a different version. Descriptions and contractual commitments that law makes binding remain binding.

sections.title: Using amen and external services
paragraphs: You must have the legal capacity to enter the relevant agreement or legally effective parental or guardian authorization where required. Use external services in accordance with their applicable conditions. Nema uses Google AI services; the provider's conditions are available at {{google}}.

Child-data and consent requirements depend on local law. Purchases require the payment and family authorization applicable to the Apple account used. The app's content rating does not override legal requirements or the conditions of another service.

sections.title: Accounts and account security
paragraphs: Amen can create a guest account during onboarding without an email address or Apple sign-in. Guest access depends on authentication information available to the app and does not provide the same sign-in and recovery options as a linked account. Existing supported accounts can use the available returning-user Apple or email/password login. Certain functions need a working account and network access. Protect account access and notify support if you suspect unauthorized use; you are not automatically responsible for every action caused by a failure outside your control. Do not use another person’s account without authorization.

The available Apple option can link or transfer supported guest-account information. Successful authentication, existing account information and app compatibility affect linking and synchronization; locally stored notes and highlights are separate. Contact support about missing information after a sign-in change. Choosing a display name does not give you a right to infringe trademarks or impersonate another person. Keep a separate copy of information important to you; this recommendation does not reduce amen's duty to provide a conforming service.

sections.title: License to use the app
paragraphs: You receive a limited, non-exclusive right to use the app personally on compatible devices you own or control, subject to the applicable agreement and law. The applicable app license is available at {{appleEula}}. Apple's usage and Family Sharing rules are available at {{appleTerms}}. The software's intellectual-property ownership is not transferred.

Do not redistribute or commercially exploit the app, bypass access controls, interfere with security or extract content unlawfully. Restrictions do not remove rights that mandatory law grants, including permitted interoperability, accessibility, lawful quotations or other statutory exceptions. Suspension and termination are governed by the provisions below rather than unrestricted revocation.

sections.title: Bible texts and spiritual content
paragraphs: Bible translations, commentary, artwork and other material can belong to amen or third-party licensors. Translation wording and denominational interpretations can differ. A generated paraphrase is not an exact Bible quotation; verify references and quotations against the translation you intend to use.

Use the in-app sharing features within their stated purpose and respect attribution and third-party licenses. Access through the app does not automatically grant rights to reproduce an entire translation, create a competing database or publish protected material commercially. Statutory quotation and other lawful-use rights remain available.

sections.title: Nema and AI-generated output
paragraphs: Nema uses an enhanced Google AI model for Bible questions and Christian reflection. Responses are generated by AI and may contain inaccurate statements, invented quotations, incorrect references or incomplete interpretations. Read answers thoughtfully and check important Bible quotations against the translation you use.

Check important answers independently. Similar outputs may be generated for others, and legal protection or exclusivity of generated material is not guaranteed. Do not represent an AI response as verified professional advice or as an authentic statement by another person. Feature availability, response speed and provider model choices can vary subject to your contractual and statutory rights.

sections.title: Professional advice and emergencies
paragraphs: Amen offers reading and reflection support. It does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, psychotherapy, legal or financial advice, emergency monitoring or a confidential pastoral relationship. A spiritual conversation is not a substitute for advice from a qualified person who understands your circumstances.

If you face immediate danger, contact your local emergency service or an appropriate crisis service. Do not rely on a chat being reviewed or answered by a human in time. Do not make medication, safety, legal or financial decisions solely from AI output. These limitations do not exclude liability where the law does not permit exclusion.

sections.title: Bible Lock, permissions and device functions
paragraphs: Bible Lock depends on Apple authorization, supported system frameworks and the apps, app categories, supported web domains and schedules you select. It can restrict selected activity as configured. Review selections before enabling it and retain access to essential device functions. You can manage authorization in system settings.

Operating-system restrictions, expired authorization, device settings or interruptions can affect blocking and unlocking. The feature is a personal routine aid and does not guarantee parental supervision, safety, treatment or uninterrupted enforcement. Reading recommendations can be generated by AI and must be reviewed like other AI content.

sections.title: Your content and permissions you grant
paragraphs: You keep the rights you hold in messages, notes, images and other submitted material. You permit amen and necessary service providers to process, store and transmit it only as needed to provide the requested functions, maintain security and meet lawful obligations, subject to the privacy policy and applicable law.

This is not a general permission to publish private chats, use your name in advertising or train models for unrelated purposes. Provider AI processing is explained in {{privacy}}. Submit only content you may lawfully use and avoid unnecessary sensitive information about other people. Shared or exported copies can remain with their recipients.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not use amen to commit unlawful acts, threaten or harass people, exploit children, infringe intellectual-property or privacy rights, distribute malicious software, obtain unauthorized access or deliberately evade safety and payment controls. Do not automate excessive requests that impair the service or bypass legitimate usage limits.

Good-faith religious discussion, questions and criticism are not themselves abuse. Restrictions must be applied proportionately and consistently with mandatory law. Report suspected misuse, infringements or security problems to {{email}} with enough detail to investigate, without sending unnecessary personal or illegal material.

sections.title: Paid access and the purchase offer
paragraphs: Amen Plus provides paid access through an Apple subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. It includes unlimited Nema conversations, premium Home and Lock Screen widgets and priority responses. Some new features may be offered to Plus users first. Before you confirm, the purchase interface shows the product, price, currency, billing period, trial or promotional conditions and included access. The specific offer defines your purchased access, subject to statutory rights.

Prices and availability can vary by storefront, tax treatment, product and offer eligibility. Purchases are charged through your Apple account, and purchase validation services help recognize your access. Amen does not receive your full payment-card number. A trial or promotion applies only when included in the confirmation screen; see {{appleTerms}} for Apple's rules.

sections.title: Trials and promotional offers
paragraphs: All new users are offered a 7-day free trial of Amen Plus at the end of onboarding. Apple's purchase confirmation shows the trial eligibility, renewal price and conditions. After trial access ends, continued app use requires an active Amen Plus subscription or a valid lifetime purchase. Cancel before Apple's displayed deadline to prevent automatic billing.

For a free or discounted trial, Apple advises cancellation at least 24 hours before the trial ends if you do not want renewal. The reminder mentioned during onboarding refers to Apple's trial-ending email, not an email from amen. Apple controls its delivery and timing; receipt is not guaranteed. Keep track of the renewal date in your Apple subscription settings; disabling notifications or removing the app does not stop billing.

sections.title: Automatic renewal and cancellation
paragraphs: Auto-renewing subscriptions continue for the stated billing period until canceled under Apple’s applicable rules. Manage cancellation in your device’s Apple account subscription settings or follow {{cancel}}. The subscription screen shows renewal dates and access after cancellation; store rules and mandatory law determine the result.

Deleting the app, deleting your amen account, signing out, emailing a cancellation request to amen or revoking permissions does not itself cancel an Apple-managed subscription. Price changes follow Apple’s notice and consent processes and applicable law. We do not claim a right to raise an existing price without required notice or agreement.

sections.title: Restoring purchases and one-time access
paragraphs: Use the available restore-purchases function with the Apple account that made the purchase. Sign in with Apple for amen and the Apple account used for App Store purchases serve different purposes. App sign-in alone does not purchase, cancel or guarantee restoration of a subscription. Access can depend on successful Apple validation, account association, device compatibility and the product's actual sharing conditions. Contact support if a validated purchase is not recognized.

A one-time or lifetime product does not auto-renew unless the offer expressly says otherwise. Its scope follows the purchase description and mandatory law; it does not automatically promise operation for the buyer's lifetime or every future service. We cannot retrospectively reduce an agreed entitlement simply by redefining it in these terms.

sections.title: Refunds and purchase problems
paragraphs: For Apple-billed purchases, use {{refund}} or reportaproblem.apple.com to request a refund or investigate billing. Eligibility depends on the applicable store rules, circumstances and law. Amen can help investigate access problems but cannot promise that Apple will grant every refund request.

This routing does not remove statutory remedies against a responsible trader. Report failures, duplicate access charges or a nonconforming service to us as well where appropriate. No clause here makes all purchases nonrefundable or requires you to abandon rights to repair, price reduction, termination or reimbursement.

sections.title: Consumer withdrawal rights
paragraphs: Where applicable consumer law grants a withdrawal period, including the usual 14-day period for relevant distance contracts in the EEA, the purchase-specific information and law determine your rights and the responsible recipient. Contact the seller identified in your purchase documentation and amen where it is the contracting party.

For digital content or services, immediate supply may affect withdrawal only if the legal conditions are met, including any required express request, consent, acknowledgment and contract confirmation. Downloading an app or reading these terms does not automatically waive withdrawal. You may use a clear statement of withdrawal; a particular form is not mandatory unless the law says otherwise.

sections.title: Statutory rights for digital services
paragraphs: Mandatory rights relating to conformity, security updates and remedies remain in force. Where the applicable law requires them, you can request that a defect be remedied and, under the relevant conditions, seek price reduction or termination. A paid feature must match binding contractual descriptions.

These protections can also apply to some services supplied in exchange for personal data rather than money. A statement that AI can make errors or that networks can fail does not remove every duty to provide a conforming service. Tell us about a defect with useful technical details so we can assess and remedy it.

sections.title: Service changes and updates
paragraphs: We may provide updates, security fixes and proportionate changes needed to operate or improve the service. For changes to an ongoing digital service, we will follow applicable requirements concerning contractual grounds, information, additional cost and any right to terminate when a change negatively affects access or use beyond a minor extent.

We will not rely on a blanket right to remove paid features without consequence. Material changes affecting your contract require the notice and agreement required by law. Install required updates after receiving appropriate information; effects of declining an update depend on law and the circumstances.

sections.title: Availability and technical requirements
paragraphs: Some functions need an internet connection, compatible iOS version, Apple permissions, active authentication and available third-party services. Maintenance, outages, provider limits or device conditions can interrupt service. We cannot promise uninterrupted access, identical output or permanent availability of a particular model.

Where an interruption prevents delivery of contracted access, your applicable remedies remain available. We will assess reported failures and take reasonable corrective steps. You are responsible for your own connection and device costs, but that responsibility does not excuse an amen defect.

sections.title: Suspension, enforcement and review
paragraphs: We may restrict access when reasonably necessary for a serious breach, misuse, a security risk, nonpayment or a legal duty. The response should be proportionate. Where appropriate, we will explain the reason and allow an opportunity to resolve the issue or request review before a lasting restriction.

Immediate action may be needed where delay would create a risk or notice is legally prohibited. Contact {{email}} if you think a restriction is wrong. Paid-access consequences and any refund or termination rights are determined by the contract and mandatory law, not an unrestricted right to block without explanation.

sections.title: Ending use and deleting an account
paragraphs: You can stop using amen and request account deletion through the app or support. Uninstalling alone does not remove cloud account information, and some device-only notes, highlights or preferences can remain separately from the account. See {{privacy}} for controls, deletion requests, lawful retention and backups. Save information you wish to keep before requesting deletion.

Cancel an Apple subscription separately to stop future billing. App removal, account deletion or ending access does not automatically cancel that store contract. If amen ends a service or your contract, we will follow applicable notice, paid-access and consumer-remedy duties. Clauses that necessarily continue, such as accrued claims and lawful retention, remain subject to law.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: Nothing in these terms excludes liability for intent, gross negligence, injury to life, body or health, fraud, a binding guarantee or liability that mandatory law makes non-excludable, including applicable product liability. Mandatory consumer compensation and refund rights are preserved.

Where German law permits, liability for simple negligence involving an essential contractual obligation is limited to foreseeable damage typical for the contract; essential obligations are those necessary to perform the agreement and on which you may normally rely. Other limitations apply only to the extent lawful in your jurisdiction. There is no blanket exclusion of all damage, AI-related harm or data loss.

sections.title: Apple rules and related information
paragraphs: App Store purchases and usage follow Apple's applicable terms: {{appleTerms}}. The applicable app license is available at {{appleEula}}, and Apple's privacy information at {{applePrivacy}}. These references explain Apple's own services and do not replace amen's responsibilities for the app.

Use Apple's cancellation and refund processes for Apple-billed subscriptions and purchases. External services and device functions have their own conditions, permissions and availability requirements. These rules apply alongside mandatory consumer rights; referring you to Apple or another provider does not remove responsibilities associated with amen.

sections.title: Privacy and consent
paragraphs: See {{privacy}} for data categories, providers, AI processing, analytics, legal bases and your rights. The policy is not a blanket consent form. Processing that requires consent, especially optional tracking or religious and other special-category information, needs a valid separate basis and any required explicit consent.

Neither acceptance of these terms nor Apple tracking permission automatically authorizes every sensitive-data use. Withdrawal and deletion requests are handled under the applicable data-protection rules. Contract and purchase rights remain distinct from privacy permissions.

sections.title: Applicable law and complaints
paragraphs: German law applies to the extent a valid choice is permitted. For consumers, this does not take away mandatory protections of the country of habitual residence where applicable. Jurisdiction follows the law; these terms do not require every consumer to sue at the provider’s location or submit to mandatory private arbitration.

Send complaints to {{email}}. Any legally required information about an appropriate alternative dispute-resolution body or participation will be supplied for the relevant dispute. The former EU online dispute-resolution platform closed in 2025 and is not presented as an available complaint route.

sections.title: Revisions, language and severability
paragraphs: The date and version above identify this text. New wording is not automatically binding on an existing contract merely because it is published or you continue to browse. For changes requiring acceptance, we will obtain it; for other permitted changes, we will give the notice and rights required by law.

All six translations are intended to have the same meaning. English fallback is a technical choice, not a rule that overrides mandatory local-language or consumer protections. If a clause is invalid, the applicable statutory rule governs and the remainder continues where legally possible; an invalid clause is not automatically replaced by the most provider-favorable wording.

sections.title: Contact support
paragraphs: Contact amen support at {{email}} for app help, account questions, subscription access or complaints. Apple's linked guidance explains its billing, cancellation and refund processes. For personal-information requests, see {{privacy}}.

Include the product or feature concerned and a concise description. Share an order reference only when needed and avoid passwords, full card details and unnecessary private conversation content. These contact instructions do not restrict legally valid notices or require use of a particular channel where the law permits another.
